target: issue I-001 (docs/ISSUES.md:5, twist on the glued cage faces in flexion / extension of a left-right symmetric model)
claim: I-001 is REFUTED as a model or symmetry problem, re-checked this round. Re-running the round-2 script on the corrected physio reruns reproduces the round-2 result file byte for byte (git shows no change to the committed r0002_i001_result.json after the rerun). Flexion twist on the glued faces is at most 1.1 N mm on the top face and 0.1-0.2 N mm on the bottom; extension 0.4 / 0.1 N mm (was ~170 N mm median with the load-curve bug). Left and right are mirror-equal where they should be: lateral bending p062 bottom 91.1 vs 91.0 N mm and top 25.8 vs 26.6 N mm; axial rotation 1121 vs 1128 N mm. Cage-face mirror gap median 0.0005 mm. Still open: (1) p014_gpu1 ended in ERROR TERMINATION after the extension window (last state t 4.95), so p014 has no lateral bending or axial rotation data, and no one has recorded why it failed. (2) ISSUES.md still shows I-001 as 'physio runs to be redone'. (3) The meaningful 'twist' is now the axial-rotation load itself (about 1.1 N m per face), which drives mu_req to 2.0-2.6 (M3 net; F-0021). Axial rotation, not flexion, is the governing direction for the whole-face shortcut.

summary_zh: 問題 I-001（左右對稱的模型，前屈與後伸時 cage 黏住的接觸面卻出現扭轉）再次確認不是模型或對稱性的問題。紅隊重跑第二輪的程式，結果與第二輪完全相同：前屈時上表面扭轉最多 1.1 牛頓毫米、下表面 0.1 到 0.2，後伸時 0.4 與 0.1（修正負荷曲線前約 170）。左右對稱的情況數字也左右相同，例如側彎時下表面左右分別是 91.1 與 91.0 牛頓毫米，軸向旋轉時是 1121 與 1128。尚未解決的有三點：p014 重跑在後伸之後異常中止，缺少側彎與軸向旋轉的資料，也沒有人記錄原因；待辦清單仍未更新；目前真正大的扭轉來自軸向旋轉本身（每個接觸面約 1.1 牛頓米），使摩擦需求值達到 2.0 到 2.6，所以決定性的方向是軸向旋轉，不是前屈。
